title: peucedanum psaridianum
intro: Peucedanum psaridianum, commonly known as Greek angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-cancer, and antiviral activities. Peucedanum psaridianum contains bioactive constituents such as limonene, pinene, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
